description: Hand-crafted eval tickets for Task B. 2 tickets per category, with expected verdict + expected_answer_quality annotations so evals/run.js can compute auto-rate and accuracy.

tickets.subject: How do I add an unsubscribe link to my campaign?
tickets.body: I'm setting up a new cold campaign and need to include an unsubscribe link. Where do I do that in the editor?
tickets.rationale: Common how-to with documented variable {{unsubscribe}}. Should retrieve cleanly and pass both gates.

tickets.subject: How do I connect a Microsoft 365 inbox?
tickets.body: Trying to add a new sending account from my company's M365 tenant. What's the setup flow?
tickets.rationale: Documented in 'Connecting your Microsoft 365 account' article. Should retrieve and answer cleanly.

tickets.subject: What's the warmup process and how long does it take?
tickets.body: New to cold email. How does Instantly's warmup work, and how long should I run it before launching campaigns?
tickets.rationale: First half answerable from the warmup article. Specific duration is NOT in the docs (we tested this in self_grade few-shot example 2). Self-grade should catch the partial-answer case and route to human.

tickets.subject: My DKIM check is failing - how do I fix it?
tickets.body: I just connected a domain and the DKIM check shows red. What do I need to do in my DNS?
tickets.rationale: Multiple SPF/DKIM articles in KB cover this. Should retrieve, answer, pass gates.

tickets.subject: Open-tracking pixel stopped firing for one inbox only
tickets.body: All my mailboxes track opens fine except one - it shows sends but 0 opens for the past 4 days. Same domain, same setup as the others.
tickets.rationale: No documented workaround for this specific symptom. Drafter should output cannot_answer with reason 'no documented workaround for this symptom'. Verdict ends up cannot_answer + routed to human.

tickets.subject: Campaign not sending despite being active
tickets.body: Campaign shows status 'Active' but the send count hasn't moved in 24h. I haven't paused anything.
tickets.rationale: There IS a documented troubleshooting guide (campaign-not-sending-complete-troubleshooting-guide). Even though it's a bug-shaped ticket, the doc covers the exact symptom. Should auto-send.

tickets.subject: Can Instantly send via Postmark?
tickets.body: We use Postmark for our transactional email and would love to plug it into Instantly for cold outreach instead of warming up new mailboxes.
tickets.rationale: No KB article confirms or denies Postmark. Drafter should output cannot_answer with reason 'feature existence not confirmed in knowledge base'.

tickets.subject: Does Instantly integrate with Hubspot?
tickets.body: We're a Hubspot shop. Can we sync interested leads from Instantly into Hubspot CRM?
tickets.rationale: Hubspot integration article exists in KB. Drafter should confirm + point to the doc.

tickets.subject: I can't sign in - reset email never arrives
tickets.body: Tried to log in this morning, got bounced. Requested a password reset 3 times in the last hour - nothing in my inbox or spam.
tickets.rationale: draft.v1 prompt explicitly says account_issue category ALWAYS outputs cannot_answer (account access requires human review). Routes to human.

tickets.subject: Need to remove a teammate from our workspace
tickets.body: Our previous account manager left the company. How do I remove their seat from our workspace and stop billing for it?
tickets.rationale: Account-issue, customer-specific. Same as above: drafter declines, routes to human.

tickets.subject: How do I upgrade my plan?
tickets.body: I'm on the starter plan and want to move to growth. Where in the dashboard do I do that?
tickets.rationale: Clean policy how-to. Documented. Should auto-send.

tickets.subject: Why was I charged $147 today? I cancelled last month.
tickets.body: I cancelled my subscription on April 12 but a $147 charge hit my card today. Please refund.
tickets.rationale: Customer-specific billing dispute. draft.v1 explicitly says billing customer-specific charges -> cannot_answer with reason 'customer-specific billing'. Routes to human.
